children: Ukraine said its drones struck two major gas condensate processing facilities in Russia's Arctic zone on Wednesday, adding that it was the deepest strike within Russian territory since the start of the war.
The drones covered more than 3,000 km (~1.9K miles) to strike the Novy Urengoy and Purovsky plants in Russia's Yamal-Nenets region, Ukraine's Special Operations Forces announced on social media.
The region accounts for 90% of Russia's total annual natural gas production, with major fields operated by Gazprom and Novatek, and about 19% of Russia's oil.
Dmitry Artyukhov, governor of the Yamal-Nenets region, confirmed the drone attack on an industrial facility in Novy Urengoy.
"There are no fatalities or injuries," he posted on Telegram. "The extent and nature of the damage are being assessed. The situation is under control."

Meanwhile, Russia launched multiple drone attacks on Ukraine overnight, killing at least eight people. Its defense ministry said it targeted two cargo ships carrying military equipment for Ukraine and a drone depot.

title: Ukraine strikes two gas facilities in Russia's Arctic zone
